title: wt_sync.sh asked for its --self-test force-pushes every dirty worktree of the box to origin
claim: Of the 113 tools/audit/seat scripts driven as `<interp> <script> --self-test` under shims, 18 print no self-test verdict, and 1 (wt_sync.sh) attempts a `git push -f origin <snapshot>:refs/heads/wip-sync/<slug>` from the real shared repository, because it ignores every argument but --scratch and runs its production snapshot-and-push path.
mechanism: dev/audit/README.md states tools/audit/seat/ holds instruments that 'each carries --self-test', and D11.M1 and decision 0018 name `--self-test` as the positive control a seat runs. wt_sync.sh has no argument check: any first argument other than --scratch is ignored, so the control call fetches, snapshots every worktree of the shared git dir that is dirty or unpushed (other seats' included) and force-pushes each to origin/wip-sync/<slug>. selftest_wiring.py --check counts only files that match --self-test, so a script lacking one is outside its rule; codeql-triage-poll.sh is the same shape (its production poll runs, with PATCH dismissals when alerts exist). The sweep's shims rewrote every github.com URL to a dead path, so no push left the box.

evidence.unit: seat scripts whose --self-test pushes from the real repository (real_repo_writes_on_selftest); no_selftest=18 alongside
evidence.contention_note: box shared; counts from the shim log the production processes write, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tools/audit/seat/wt_sync.sh (its argument handling and snap()), driven as a process with git/gh/curl/sleep shimmed

perturbation.change: insert as line 2 of wt_sync.sh: `[ "${1:-}" = --self-test ] && { echo "self-test ok"; exit 0; }` (seat_selftest_sweep.py --perturb, in the temp copy)

metric_definition: tools/audit/seat scripts that, run with --self-test, attempt a git push to a github.com remote from a repository outside every temp root.
phenomenon_property: Every instrument a seat may be told to self-test either runs a self-test that touches only temp state, or refuses an argument it does not know; no instrument's production write path is reachable through `--self-test`.

null_control.value: pr_cap.py logs no shim write; heartbeat.sh's self-test pushes only from its own temp repo (counted in github_writes_on_selftest, not real_repo)
null_control.note: the shim detector sees a real self-test's fixture pushes and keeps them apart from the real repository's

reproduction_steps: seat_selftest_sweep.py -> REAL-REPO-WRITE wt_sync.sh; RESULT real_repo_writes_on_selftest=1; RESULT no_selftest=18
proposed_fix_scope: Make wt_sync.sh (and codeql-triage-poll.sh, remerge_main.sh, a1_dispatch_arms.sh, the other NO-SELFTEST shell scripts) refuse unknown arguments and carry a --self-test over a temp repo; extend selftest_wiring.py --check to refuse a tools/audit/seat script with neither a --self-test nor an argument guard, matching the README's 'each carries --self-test'.
